root_text:
🚨BREAKING: Two children in Nagpur diagnosed with human metapneumovirus (HMPV). 

The Union Health Secretary has reviewed the situation and urged states to ramp up awareness and preventive measures. 

Stay tuned for updates!

#hmpvvirus #Nag
